source_parent.F104_negative: F60 fixed 2/24, both learned causal structural F104 policies 0/24; TRAIN F60 44 positive, F102 on-policy zero; 15 same-feature contradictory credit vectors. Already consumed F104 GUARD must never be used for F105 training or model selection.

question: Does a richer ONLINE inspectable record-composition representation paired with an 8-event bounded multi-action fixed-continuation TRAIN-only teacher improve native 144B delayed correctness on fresh public source-disjoint GUARD streams relative to F60 and exact same-new-TRAIN 12-feature objective controls?

case_splits.constraints: F62 negative unregistered source constructor only; exactly 72 event/native episode, 12 x 12B retained memory (144B), true native candidate actions, no original FIT/DIAG/ORIGINAL or previously consumed F102–F104 guard identities. F62 graph topology grammar reused; changing symbols/order is not different latent graph family.

online_representation.base: F62's original 12-dimensional per-candidate source-native action difference vector, compared against fixed F60 action on CURRENT memory.
online_representation.added_eight: Candidate minus local F60 baseline, all derivable from CURRENT retained memory and arrived edge, not answer or future: [number of native records, total signed role hops, multi-role record count, distinct visible endpoints, ordered two-record signed-composition joins, ordered three-record joins, incident-to-current-event endpoint count, repeated endpoint-pair records].
online_representation.interpretability: Record per-action 8-component causal graph-state features and counterfactual action comparison; separately zero out only the eight added inputs at evaluation without retraining weights to quantify their attribution. Missing features/answers lead to fail-closed assertion.
online_representation.online_budget: No greater than twelve retained records. Extra ephemeral compute and 20 fitted parameters must be reported; this is NOT resource/parameter matched to native fixed policy. F105 only compares native persistent bytes and source access, not full compute or neural parity.

supervision.origins: TRAIN only. On F60 teacher-owned native states at checkpoints [11,23,35,47,59,71] enumerate every real F62 legal candidate. For each, let actual frozen F60 `_finish_fixed` process NEXT up to eight arrived TRAIN public events from that candidate state. Offline reconstruct final eventual answer signed source path from fully observed TRAIN graph; score exact native retained record overlap with contiguous path segments AFTER that continuation. Target sign relative to the local F60 action under same continuation. No hidden query/sign/path ever available to online learned scorer or GUARD.
supervision.action_labels: {-1,0,+1} signed potential difference. Count positive, negative, zero and feature label collisions. At checkpoint 71 continuation length 0. NOT objective-equivalent to actual final delayed correctness; GUARD answer scored only once after entire stream.
supervision.fit: One 12-feature linear tanh SGD (same NEW TRAIN multi-step labels), one 20-feature 12+8 graph-state linear tanh SGD, and one 20-feature same weights with eight graph features ablated only at GUARD inference. Four sequential passes, learning rate 0.04, zero initialization, parameter clamp [-7.9375,7.9375]. No guard fitting, normalization or after-results tuning.
baselines: unchanged F102 original 12 weights re-fit exclusively on F102 original TRAIN (never its guard)
F105 12-weight same NEW TRAIN multi-step labels
F105 same 20 weights with 8 relational features ablated
supervision.trace: Record terminal question correctness per case, native memory byte cap, per-case graph source identity hash, model train vector/epoch, label counts, per-online checkpoint action trace and full graph-state feature components on a bounded subset.

precommitted_gates.structural_validity: All labels computed TRAIN only; exactly 16 TRAIN and four x eight untouched GUARD; native action source unchanged; 20 features fully answer-blind online; 144B cap; no episode identity overlap or extra original source; empty/uninformative labels allowed as negative.
precommitted_gates.information: Both sign labels ±1 must occur in TRAIN for credit feasibility. If not, NO_NONTRIVIAL_TRAIN_CREDIT. No resampling or label correction after outcome.
precommitted_gates.new_representation_screen: 20-feature model must beat 12-feature on each GUARD family or tie, and win by >=4/32 pooled, with nonzero heldout intervention impact when zeroing the eight added features. Else NO_REPRESENTATION_GAIN.
precommitted_gates.actual_delayed_memory_screen: 20-feature model must exceed F60 by >=4/32, never lose to F60 on any GUARD family, and beat original F102; otherwise NEGATIVE even if model wins over 12-feature.
precommitted_gates.causal_inspectability_limit: Eight-dimensional ablation is feature intervention on a TRAIN-fitted scorer, not proof of faithful causal memory-cell attribution; F101 records are separately available. Does not establish novel architecture superiority over neural/symbolic baselines.
precommitted_gates.future: If this fails, prefer representational identifiability studies and multi-step credit oracle upper bounds before any more fitted scoring controllers. No hindsight choice of best variants.
